title: THE TRUTH BEHIND THE BROKEN SCOOTER! 🛴

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: GIVE ME BACK MY SCOOTER NIX [beat] OR I AM TELLING THE PRINCIPAL YOU TRASHED IT BEYOND REPAIR RIGHT NOW!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Go ahead and tell her Bruno! [beat] Because I didn't trash it, I spent the whole night at the shop fixing it for your little brother!

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: Is this true Nix? [beat] Bruno’s brother was crying all morning because he thought his birthday gift was ruined by the rain and mud!

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: Wait, you actually stayed up all night [beat] just so my little brother wouldn't find out it was broken by the neighborhood dogs?

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Yeah, I saw them knocking it over [beat] and I knew your dad would blame you, so I used my own savings to replace the bent handle bars.

lines.speaker: milli
lines.text: My brother is a hero! [beat] He even used his lunch money for the entire week just to buy the custom neon stickers your brother wanted!

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: I spent the last month trying to get you expelled [beat] and you were out here saving my reputation with my family? I am a total jerk.

lines.speaker: rafiq
lines.text: I have never been prouder of you, Nix. [beat] You turned a neighborhood war into a lesson about looking out for each other even when it is hard.

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: Bruno, I think you owe Nix more than just an apology. [beat] The midnight scooter war officially ends today, thanks to Nix’s selflessness.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: I do not want your money, Bruno. [beat] Just promise me you will not bully the younger kids anymore and we are officially even for life.

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: I promise, Nix. [beat] From now on, anyone who messes with you or the little kids has to deal with me first. You have my word.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And that is how Nix proved [beat] that in this world, kindness is the only currency that actually buys you a completely clean slate.
